findings.summary: CQ07 driver id: run.created records the driver but reconstruct drops it; the bundle's versions.driver is the exporting runtime's driver, not the run's.
CQ07 rule versions: passed rules' versions are in validation.completed but the ledger keeps only non-PASS findings; rule_bundle_version is in no event payload.
CQ06: leaving out expected/observed is correct (PR-26) but the ADR 0033 CQ06 row contradicts its own section; record the ruling.
OpenFinding.message (validator free text) passes into the explanation unfiltered, and the no-observation test covers no failing validation.

Confirmed: explain is pure and deterministic, string fields trace to ids/versions/statuses/digests/task text, old runs partial, the bundle key extension is additive, the CLI keeps the tenant scope, README lists it.
